name: What factors influence the cost of installing under-cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of installing under-cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to add under-cabinet lighting depends on the number of cabinet runs, fixture quality, wiring complexity, and power supply placement. On a standard kitchen renovation, dedicating a portion of the electrical budget covers dedicated circuits, low-voltage transformers, dimmers, and professional installation. Factors that increase scope include routing wires across broken wall sections—such as gaps created by a range hood or window—which require separate wire runs or multiple transformers. Opting for integrated, dimmable LED channels during rough-in reduces labor compared to attempting to retrofit wiring after finishes are complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on fixture quality, linear footage, dedicated wall controls, and whether wiring must cross gaps like windows or range hoods requiring multiple drivers.
